Get!! Colonies.name: Get!! Colonies
Get!! Colonies.summary:
Puzzle game on the Sega Dreamcast. Object of the game is to fill the playfield with more of your colored spheres than your opponent.

Get!! Colonies was originally released as "Hello Kitty: Lovely Fruit Park"... no... seriously, it was. The game was then re-skinned for a wider audience.

Omoide ni Kawaru Kimi - Memories Off.name: Omoide ni Kawaru Kimi: Memories Off
Omoide ni Kawaru Kimi - Memories Off.summary: The third game in the Memories Off franchise.

Sega Worldwide Soccer 2000 - Euro Editio.name: Sega Worldwide Soccer 2000: Euro Edition
Sega Worldwide Soccer 2000 - Euro Editio.summary: Sega Worldwide Soccer is a series of soccer games by Sega for initially for the Sega Saturn but later was moved to the Dreamcast. They were released between 1995 and the year 2000.

Spider-Man.name: Spider-Man
Spider-Man.summary: Spider-Man is an action-adventure game developed by Neversoft. Players control Spider-Man as he navigates levels using web-swinging, combat, and stealth mechanics. The story involves a conspiracy featuring villains such as Doctor Octopus and Venom.

Test Drive Le Mans.name: Test Drive: Le Mans
Test Drive Le Mans.summary: Take on the LeMans endurance racing challenge! Join one of the 25 factory teams take one of the over 50 vehicles (designed with assistance of actual teams) on the eight different LeMans circuits. The actual wear and tear are simulated. Tire wear, oil and fuel consumptions... Day and night and back to day driving.
